notes: DeepFlux 5.1 — the Room tab now speaks the OnlyHumans protocol: every word is a room. DeepFlux auto-joins the community room “deepflux” at launch (a deepfluxuser#### name is generated for you), you can rename live, create rooms from any word, and chat with people on the OnlyHumans app and the browser portal — same word, same room. Messages are sealed end-to-end; room history stays on your machine.
